entries.plain_en: hi-hat — the 'tss-tss-tss' cymbals keeping steady time in the beat

entries.music_theory_en: drum kit (drum set — integrated setup of kick, snare, toms, hi-hat and cymbals for one player)
entries.plain_ko: 드럼 키트 — 킥·스네어·심벌즈가 한 세트로 갖춰진 드럼 세트
entries.plain_en: drum kit — the full drum set with kick, snare and cymbals

entries.music_theory_en: shaker (handheld percussion filled with granular material, producing steady sixteenth-note 'chick' patterns)
entries.plain_ko: 셰이커 — 흔들면 착착착 모래알 굴리는 소리로 잔박자를 채우는 타악기
entries.plain_en: shaker — the soft 'chick-chick-chick' of sand or beads shaken in rhythm

entries.music_theory_en: beat (the rhythmic pattern/groove of a track — in production contexts, the programmed drum track as a whole)
entries.plain_ko: 비트 — 곡 전체를 끌고 가는 리듬 패턴, 흔히 힙합·전자음악의 드럼 리듬을 뜻함
entries.plain_en: beat — the rhythmic groove driving the track, often a programmed drum pattern

entries.music_theory_en: crash cymbal (accent cymbal producing an explosive wash of sound, marks section transitions and downbeats)
entries.plain_ko: 크래시 심벌 — 콰앙! 하고 터지듯 울려 곡의 전환을 알리는 큰 심벌즈
entries.plain_en: crash cymbal — the big 'crash!' that explodes at dramatic moments

entries.music_theory_en: rimshot (snare stroke hitting head and rim simultaneously, producing a loud sharp crack; also loosely used for rim-click sounds)
entries.plain_ko: 림샷 — 스네어 북면과 테두리를 동시에 때려 딱! 하고 유난히 날카롭게 튀는 소리
entries.plain_en: rimshot — an extra-sharp 'crack!' from striking the drum head and rim together

entries.music_theory_en: woodblock (slotted hardwood idiophone struck with a stick, dry high-pitched 'tock')
entries.plain_ko: 우드블록 — 나무토막을 두드려 딱딱 마른 소리를 내는 타악기
entries.plain_en: woodblock — a dry, hollow 'tock-tock' from a struck block of wood

entries.music_theory_en: cymbal (metal plate idiophone — generic reference covering crash, ride, hi-hat and effects cymbals)
entries.plain_ko: 심벌즈 — 챙- 하고 금속성으로 길게 울리는 둥근 금속판 타악기
entries.plain_en: cymbal — the shimmering metallic 'crash' or 'ping' of a metal disc

entries.music_theory_en: clap (handclap sample or ensemble handclaps used as backbeat/accent, ubiquitous in electronic and pop production)
entries.plain_ko: 클랩 — 짝짝 손뼉 치는 소리, 전자음악에서 스네어 대신 박자를 짚는 데 자주 쓰임
entries.plain_en: clap — the 'clap-clap' handclap sound marking the beat

entries.music_theory_en: cowbell (handheld or mounted metal bell struck with a stick, dry clanking tone; Latin and funk idiom)
entries.plain_ko: 카우벨 — 깡깡 울리는 금속 방울 타악기, 라틴·펑크 리듬의 감초
entries.plain_en: cowbell — the metallic 'clank-clank' bell that spices up a groove

entries.music_theory_en: finger snap (snapped-finger percussion sound used as a light backbeat, often in place of a snare or clap)
entries.plain_ko: 핑거 스냅 — 딱딱 손가락 튕기는 소리로 가볍게 박자를 맞추는 효과
entries.plain_en: finger snap — the light 'snap-snap' of fingers keeping the beat

entries.music_theory_en: ride cymbal (large cymbal played with continuous stick patterns, sustained 'ping' timekeeping; jazz ride patterns)
entries.plain_ko: 라이드 심벌 — 팅-팅-팅 은은하게 이어 치며 박자를 끌고 가는 큰 심벌즈
entries.plain_en: ride cymbal — the steady 'ping-ping-ping' cymbal riding along with the beat

entries.music_theory_en: tambourine (frame drum with metal jingles, shaken or struck; adds bright rhythmic sparkle)
entries.plain_ko: 탬버린 — 찰랑찰랑 방울 소리로 리듬에 반짝임을 더하는 타악기
entries.plain_en: tambourine — the jingling 'ch-ch-ch' shake adding sparkle to the rhythm

entries.music_theory_en: tom (tom-tom — cylindrical drum of the kit without snares, tuned high to low, used for fills and rolling patterns)
entries.plain_ko: 탐(탐탐) — 두둥두둥 굴러가듯 울리는 드럼 세트의 중간 북들
entries.plain_en: tom — the rolling 'doom-doom' drums used for fills on a drum kit

entries.music_theory_en: cross-stick (side-stick — stick laid across the snare head striking the rim, producing a dry woody click; bossa nova and ballad idiom)
entries.plain_ko: 크로스 스틱 — 스틱을 스네어에 눕혀 테두리를 딱딱 치는 마른 나무 소리, 보사노바에서 자주 들림
entries.plain_en: cross-stick — a dry, woody 'tick' made by tapping the drum rim with the stick laid flat
